answer_1.quote: This study presents a model training pipeline for distractor generation.

answer_2.quote: The performance of our distractor generator is evaluated using the following metrics: (1) Plausibility ... (2) Human Evaluation ...

answer_3.quote: We instruct the model to generate reasoning about (1) the knowledge being tested ... and (2) why each of the two given distractors might appear plausible to students.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation where actual students assess the difficulty of distractors generated by our method.
answer_4.guideline: The survey was designed to begin only after they agreed to provide their results for research purposes and acknowledged the precautions via an online form.
